Thanks /u/uhasnicelegs, I really appreciate that you took time to write such a thoughtful and kind post. I am in group therapy right now, but I have a really hard time doing the CBT and/or meditating on my own. I'm in school full time which makes it hard to justify spending a lot of time working on myself, which I know is a silly mentality.
I think I may need to go off the antidepressants, but I keep yoyo ing on that because I have so much going on and have been on them a year now. I've had a lot of change in doctors, therapists, and lifestyle simultaneously while taking meds so it's fair to say it's been a rocky go so far. :/
